items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: I built an app that turns typing practice into language practice
items.contentSnippet:
I used to play TypeRacer a lot and wanted to turn that into some language practice.
I’ve built an app where you first type a sentence with the English translation visible, then type it again from memory. I’ve added a couple more things, like mini lessons and the option to save words for recall.
I’d love to hear what you think.

items.title: Show HN: Cordium – FOSS sandbox platform on Kubernetes to eliminate credentials
items.contentSnippet: Hello HN. Cordium is a FOSS, self-hosted, identity-based, general-purpose sandbox platform built on Kubernetes. items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN,
I originally made this game as a bit of fun between some friends and family. Turned out they quite enjoyed it and encouraged me to share it around a bit.
Everyone in your group is given the same 15 letters, you're given five minutes to find the best words you can with the letters provided, scrabble style scoring. One of the letters is a 2x tile, that will double your points for that word.

items.title: Show HN: Agent Doctor – let domain experts tune your agent without code changes
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN , I'm Abhinav Prakash and I built Agent Doctor. It lets a domain expert (lawyer, doctor, banker) change steps in an AI agent and re-run it on your own servers, without code changes or redeploys.
I would like to learn: how does your domain expert's feedback reach your agent today? I'd also really value a review of what I built, what's missing and what's wrong.
Thanks  !
